source.name: Arabic Wikipedia — 1956 Tunisian National Constituent Assembly
source.coverage: ANC-1956: full 98-member roster with constituencies; Aug 1956 by-elections; presiding officers; aggregate occupational composition
source.reliability_notes: Tertiary source. Names and constituencies are reproduced from Martin (2003) and Ghorbal (2011) but are not individually footnoted. The article contradicts itself on which member Ahmed Amara replaced. No birth dates, occupations or biographies are given per member. All rows require JORT verification before use as evidence; see docs/RECONSTRUCTION_PROTOCOL.md.

internal_conflicts: صالح بالعيش: roster table says replaced by 'أحمد عمارة', by-election list says 'البحري بربوش' (by-election list preferred)

notes: Parsed 98 seated members and 10 by-election replacements. 1 internal contradiction(s) detected and recorded rather than resolved.
